name: Bug fix
description: Reproduce, fix and regression-test a specific defect.
about: Fix a known bug in {area} with a failing-test-first approach.
title: Fix: {symptom}
description:
Bug in {area}: {symptom}.
Root-cause it first; add a regression test that reproduces the bug BEFORE changing production code, then make it pass with the smallest correct change.
acceptance_criteria:
Given the reproduction steps: {repro}
When the regression test runs against the fixed code
Then the test passes
And the original symptom no longer occurs
And no unrelated behavior changed (existing tests still pass)
